# Qdrant synthetic example
Reranking is a precision step after candidate retrieval. This is an author-written test example, not a production source.

# Qdrant Hybrid Search synthetic example
Dense embeddings and BM25 feed hybrid search; the candidate set then enters reranking. The query also uses late interaction embeddings. This author-written regression sample makes no latency claim.
